verdict.rationale: A first-party GitHub repository (github.com/stackblitz/bolt.new) describes the Bolt.new product itself, which suggests its source is publicly readable. However, nothing in the evidence states a license or confirms the repo matches the current hosted product. Code view only exposes users' own project code, not the product's source, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license, confirmation that the repo is the current production codebase, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Bolt.new gives AI models complete control over the entire environment including the filesystem, node server, package manager, terminal, and browser console.
